name: Kyrkoryr - Kynnefjälls natur
description: Kyrkoryr to Kynnefjälls natur. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: KynnefjällsNatur: Official stage-end accommodation/service node. WST categories include lodging, drinking water and toilet; operator site describes accommodation, showers/laundry/packed lunch and food/restaurant options.
notes: Current official Stage 18 is Kyrkoryr to Kynnefjälls natur. Several third-party pages and Naturkartan/AllTrails slugs retain Svarteborg-Lunden language from older staging.
WST/Naturkartan classify Stage 18 as Blue/medium, while Munkedal/Västsverige call it easy/lätt.
WST/Naturkartan end at [58.618192, 11.690120], OSM shared Stage 18/19 endpoint is [58.618528, 11.689299] about 60.4 m away, and KynnefjällsNatur operator geocode is close to the OSM/service cluster.
Bredmossen, Svarteborg, Gadderöd and related place records are associated with Stage 18 by WST/other data but lie 3.3-4.1 km from current Stage 18 geometry.
The operator page says KynnefjällsNatur is 5 km from Bohusleden and has connecting trails, while current WST/Naturkartan Stage 18 ends near the facility.
WST English text uses Kärsjön once; other sources and local geography use Kärnsjön.
